question: Hari travels from City A to City B. If Hari drives his car at (2)/(3) of his normal speed, then he reaches City B 30 minutes late. Find the time (in minutes) that Hari would have taken to travel from City A to City B if he drove at his normal speed.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a constant distance, Speed and Time are inversely proportional.

Speed ratio (New : Normal) = 2 : 3 ⇒ Time ratio (New : Normal) = 3 : 2

Difference in time ratio = 3 − 2 = 1 unit

Given, the delay is 1 unit = 30 minutes.

Normal time corresponds to 2 units ⇒ 2 × 30 = 60 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 60 minutes.**
